name: ZD Studios Game Library
description: A growing collection of free browser games. No installs, no accounts. Every game is a single standalone HTML file that runs in the browser. Games were built with heavy use of AI plus a lot of human direction and effort.

for_ai_agents.summary: This manifest is the machine-readable catalogue of the whole library. Everything an agent needs about each game (what it is, how to play it, how it is built, where its source is) is in the games array.
how_to_use: To let a user play a game, give them the game.play.url link; it opens in a new browser tab.
To read or modify a game, fetch game.source.raw_url; each game is one self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript.
game.code lists the rendering engine, libraries, networking, save data and external resources found in that file.
play.single_player / online_multiplayer / local_multiplayer match the badges on the library page.
origin.section "suggested-by-the-public" means the game was built from an idea sent in through the feedback box; origin.credit says who to credit.
notes: If the library home page shows an "Under maintenance" notice, the library is temporarily closed. The individual game URLs still work.
Online multiplayer needs the ZD Studios multiplayer server (mp.zdstudios.network); the games fall back to offline modes where they have them.
Games work on PC (keyboard and mouse). Many are not designed for mobile.
This file is regenerated from the repository with: node tools/build-manifest.js

repository_conventions.one_game_per_file: Each game is a single .html file at the repo root. index.html is the library launcher and mini-arcade.html is a bundle of small arcade games.
repository_conventions.adding_a_game: Drop the .html file at the repo root and push to main. /api/games lists it automatically. Optionally add an entry to GAME_INFO (plus FEATURED / MULTIPLAYER) in index.html for a custom card.
repository_conventions.deployment: Pushing to main auto-deploys to games.zdstudios.network (Express static server, server.js). GitHub Pages copy redirects to it.
repository_conventions.offline_policy: Libraries and fonts are inlined so games run without internet; CDNs are kept only as fallbacks. Only the multiplayer SDK is loaded from the ZD Studios server.
library_features: search and filters by player mode
a "Got a game idea?" / feedback box with replies chat (ZD Studios Feedback Hub)
seasonal themes and a maintenance mode, controlled by true/false flags at the top of index.html
Discrete Mode, an alternate disguised view of the page
